Name: Woman of Tekoa
Summary: The wise woman of Tekoa — unnamed in the text — was sent by Joab to David in mourning dress with a parable about her two sons, one dead and one threatened. Her story moved David to bring Absalom back from exile.
KeyStory: The woman of Tekoa's parable of two sons moved David to recall his exiled son.
LifeLesson: A parable told by a stranger can open a king's eyes to his own house.
